> **grepai works issue first and does not accept pull requests.**
>
> Please open an issue instead ([bug](https://github.com/yoanbernabeu/grepai/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) or [feature](https://github.com/yoanbernabeu/grepai/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)). You can paste your description and diff there: they help write the fix, and you are credited in the changelog. This pull request will be closed. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/yoanbernabeu/grepai/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
